types.name: BusinessType
types.description: The legal structure of the applicant business.

values.description: A business type not otherwise modeled.

types.name: DirectorIDType
types.description: The type of identification document supplied as Director ID.

values.description: A form of identification not modeled as valid director ID.

rules.expression: (= hasRequiredDocuments (and hasRecentBankStatements hasValidDirectorID hasProofOfDirectorAddress hasAccountsOrManagementInformation (or (not isVATRegistered) hasVATReturns) (or (not hasExistingBorrowing) hasBorrowingDetails)))
(= isSubstantivelyEligible (and isUKBased isEligibleBusinessType isApplicantAgeEligible loanAmountInRange meetsMinimumTradingHistory loanTermInRange personalGuaranteeRequirementMet))

variables.name: bankStatementsMonthsCount
variables.description: The number of months of bank statements supplied by the applicant. Policy requires at least 3 months.

variables.name: mostRecentStatementAgeDays
variables.description: The age, in days, of the most recent bank statement measured from the date of application. Policy requires this to be less than 90 days.

variables.name: hasRecentBankStatements
variables.description: True if the supplied bank statements meet the recency/sufficiency rule: at least 3 months of statements and the most recent statement is less than 90 days old on the date of application. Determined deterministically by the check_bank_statements_recent_and_sufficient tool.

variables.name: isRegisteredInUK
variables.description: True if the business is registered in the UK (i.e. has a UK registration).

variables.name: hasUKAddress
variables.description: True if the business has a UK address.

variables.name: isUKBased
variables.description: True if the business is UK-based, meaning it is registered in the UK and has a UK address.

variables.name: hasCompaniesHouseMatch
variables.description: True if there is a confirmed Companies House match for the business (via the check_companies_house check). A confirmed match is itself proof that the business is both registered in the UK and has a UK address.

variables.name: businessType
variables.description: The legal structure of the applicant business. Must be a limited company or partnership (not a sole trader) to be eligible.

variables.name: isEligibleBusinessType
variables.description: True if the business is an eligible business type: a limited company or a partnership (not a sole trader).

variables.name: directorIDType
variables.description: The type of identification document supplied as Director ID. Valid Director ID is a driver's licence or a passport.

variables.name: hasValidDirectorID
variables.description: True if a valid Director ID (a driver's licence or a passport) has been supplied.

variables.name: applicantAge
variables.description: The age of the applicant in years. Must be 18 or older to be eligible.

variables.name: isApplicantAgeEligible
variables.description: True if the applicant is aged 18 or older.

variables.name: loanAmount
variables.description: Requested loan_amount or facility limit in GBP.

variables.name: loanAmountInRange
variables.description: Whether requested amount is between GBP 1000 and 500000, inclusive.

variables.name: tradingHistoryMonths
variables.description: Complete months of business trading history.

variables.name: meetsMinimumTradingHistory
variables.description: Whether the business meets the minimum 6 months trading history.

variables.name: hasProofOfDirectorAddress
variables.description: Proof of director address is supplied.

variables.name: hasAccountsOrManagementInformation
variables.description: Accounts or management information is supplied; any filed accounts relied upon meet the general policy recency rule.

variables.name: isVATRegistered
variables.description: Business is VAT registered.

variables.name: hasVATReturns
variables.description: VAT returns are supplied.

variables.name: hasExistingBorrowing
variables.description: Business has existing borrowing.

variables.name: hasBorrowingDetails
variables.description: Details of existing borrowing are supplied.

variables.name: loanTermMonths
variables.description: Requested loan_term in months.

variables.name: loanTermInRange
variables.description: Whether the requested loan term is within 3 through 60 months inclusive.

variables.name: hasPersonalGuarantee
variables.description: A personal guarantee has been agreed for this loan.

variables.name: personalGuaranteeRequirementMet
variables.description: Whether the personal guarantee requirement is met: required strictly above GBP25000; not required at or below GBP25000.

variables.name: hasRequiredDocuments
variables.description: Whether all documents required for unsecured-business-loans have been supplied, including conditional documents when applicable. Missing information is unknown, not automatically true.

variables.name: isSubstantivelyEligible
variables.description: Whether all substantive eligibility conditions for unsecured-business-loans are met. Missing documentation alone is not substantive ineligibility.

variables.name: approvalMeetsCoveredPolicy
variables.description: Whether a proposed approval meets the covered eligibility and document requirements for unsecured-business-loans. An approved outcome asserts this is true. Rejection or referral alone does not assert it is false. Other assessments may still prevent approval.
